metadata.title: Verify email
metadata.description: Verify your email address for your {appName} account.

pending.title: Check your inbox
pending.description: We sent an email to <address>{email}</address>. Open the link in it and you'll continue where you left off. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. If it isn't in your inbox, check your spam folder.
pending.unverified: Your email address isn't confirmed yet, so we sent a new link to <address>{email}</address>. Open it and you'll continue where you left off. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. If it isn't in your inbox, check your spam folder.
pending.askEmail: Enter the email address of your account and we'll send you a link to confirm it. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

invalid.title: This link no longer works
invalid.description: It has expired or was already used. We'll send a new one to <address>{email}</address>, and it works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
invalid.askEmail: It has expired or was already used. Enter the email address of your account and we'll send you a new one.

confirmed.title: Your email is confirmed
confirmed.description: This email address is already confirmed. Sign in to continue.
